==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Warrior
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
*Find and kill the Kaguchi brothers. 
*See Headmaster Zhan for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]]
* [[Bronze Shield]]
: [[Armor]] +10 (Req. 4 [[Strength]])
: Received [[physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 15%)

==Walkthrough==
[[Category:Walkthrough needed]]
Journeying from [[Tsumei Village]], head to the western side of [[Panjiang Peninsula]]. The Kaguchi brothers can be found just north of [[Pei the Skull Blade]]'s ship.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Human]]s
*{{r}} 8 [[Buqui Kaguchi]] 
*{{r}} 8 [[Nongbu Kaguchi]] 

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Headmaster Zhan
:''"We Warriors are blessed with superior strength and skill, and each of us must choose how we use these gifts: we can protect those weaker than ourselves, or we can take advantage of them. I have sworn to protect the weak, and it is my hope that you will do the same.''
:''You recall the gang of crop thieves you dispatched earlier? They were employed by the Kaguchi brothers, notorious criminals in these parts. I understand the brothers are busy recruiting more outlaws, so unless we stop them now, we can expect only more trouble from them in the near future. What do you say, <Character name>, will you use your skills to put an end to the '''Kaguchu brothers'''' villainy once and for all?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = You can rely on me.
| decline = I'll have to think about it.
| ask = Use your skills to aid the weak. Find and kill the '''Kaguchi brothers''' to put an end to their criminal doings.
| indent = ::
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
:'''Nongbu Kaguchi:''' ''"Look, Buqui! This peasant is pretending to be a Warrior!"''
:'''Buqui Kaguchi:''' ''"Nongbu, for shame! This sewer rat would be fortunate indeed to be called a peasant!"''
:'''Nongbu Kaguchi:''' ''"Ha ha! Let us finish this quickly, brother. A draught of Canthan ale awaits us at the tavern, and this Warrior has volunteered to pay our tab!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Zhan
:''"I am pleased to learn of your success, <Character name>. The Kaguchi brothers were nefarious killers, and your victory over them speaks volumes for your character, honor, and ability.''
:''Master Togo will wish to speak with you again now that you have completed the advanced courses. Seek him out in Linnok Courtyard when you have a moment."''
